decisions.reason: The Title font-size change alters a typography value but does not change the requirement to apply the style system consistently across all templates.
The source changes the Title font size only and does not change bullet size, alignment, balance, scaling, or the bullet design reference.
Changing the Title font size does not alter the required legacy copy-paste behavior, test sources, or target template version.
The source does not change Tab-key behavior, list hierarchy, indentation, or alignment across list levels.
The Title font-size decision does not affect the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source does not address table structures, pasted columns, page margins, or the existing table-adjustment conflict.
The typography decision does not change the due-diligence assessment steps, outputs, coverage, method, or time budget.
